data.title: Iran military industrial capacity at 50%, produces 50 ballistic missiles a month | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Despite major damage to its military infrastructure, the Islamic Republic of Iran "likely has at least 1,700 ballistic missiles remaining," and is building more every day, according to reports.
